name: CoP - Provider A Completes, Provider B Posts
description: Provider A creates a short course, the employer approves it, and Provider A completes the learner (claiming 30% milestone and completion in a single PUT). Provider B then creates a new short course for the same learner on the same course.

steps.name: SLD (Provider A) Creates a Short Course
Employer Approves Provider A Short Course
SLD (Provider A) Claims 30% Milestone and Completes
SLD (Provider B) Creates a Short Course
